conversationData.topic: First, I got an indoors campfire set up. My measurement-devices measured the fire at 180°C
Afterwards, I mixed together a pound of prey in a bowl, with two to four ping pong balls and some greens.
I also added the ingredient of anger, a secure-spicer, a cromch of bread, and a hacked sadness-spreader.
The ingredients then were mixed and rolled into small balls and put onto a baking plate.
I put the small balls into the fireplace for 20 to 30 minutes, until brown.
In the meantime, I put a bit of water in a pot, let it cook, and then I added long webby thingies until soft.
After the small balls are done, I prepared yum yum sauce in another pot and let it cook for 20 minutes at low heat.
